bedrock.label: AWS Bedrock
bedrock.note: Spelling bedrock-standard added 26 Oct (gaps-configdates): obviousbench bedrock_flex.py names Inspect's native bedrock route as the Standard route. Spelling bedrock-flex added 26 Oct (gaps2-obv-routes): obviousbench providers/bedrock_flex.py (commit fe6d00a, 23 Jul 2026), class BedrockFlexAPI, sends Bedrock Converse requests to the bedrock-runtime endpoint (/model/{model_id}/converse) with serviceTier {"type": "flex"}; the Flex tier is a price-tier fact (F14), not a route.
